timeline.text: Takko: start with an idea in your own words. This is a UI walkthrough, with no model call.
Models is your reusable library. Add a provider and model once.
Choose a provider, pick from its catalog, and enter the API key locally.
Presets keep the model roles and spending limits together for reuse.
Creating the project saves your idea. Shape my idea is the separate model action.
Then review choices, answer or delegate, and approve the direction before planning. Live results follow only after a working key is connected.

disclosure: Actual UI recording, no inference. Empty demonstration workspace, no credentials.
